_note: 學習路徑內容第25批 #2／6：used to / be used to / get used to 辨析（eng.t_adv.verb.used-to-family，學測級／高階）。used to + 原形＝過去習慣/狀態（現在不再）；be used to + 名詞/V-ing＝已習慣（狀態）；get used to + 名詞/V-ing＝逐漸習慣（過程）。關鍵：be/get used to 的 to 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing；used to（過去習慣）的 to 是不定詞記號，後接原形。誘答鎖『該用原形卻用 -ing／該用 -ing 卻用原形／be 與 used 混用』等結構性錯誤。為避美式/英式否定式分歧地雷，正解一律用肯定句、不含 didn't use(d) to。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix uto_）。

units.title_zh: used to／be used to／get used to 辨析
units.can_do: 我能分辨 used to + 原形（過去習慣）、be used to + 名詞/V-ing（已習慣）、get used to + 名詞/V-ing（逐漸習慣），並正確接續後面的詞類。
units.situation_group: 動詞片語：used to 家族辨析
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'used to + base verb' describes a past habit or state that is no longer true now: 'I used to play the piano when I was young.'
claims.verification_ref: used to + 原形＝過去習慣/狀態、現在不再（I used to play the piano）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'be used to + noun or verb-ing' means 'be accustomed to' something; the 'to' here is a preposition, so it is followed by a noun or an -ing form, not a base verb: 'She is used to living alone.'
claims.verification_ref: be used to + 名詞/V-ing＝已習慣（to 為介系詞，接名詞或 -ing）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'get used to + noun or verb-ing' means 'gradually become accustomed to' something: 'I am getting used to the cold weather.'
claims.verification_ref: get used to + 名詞/V-ing＝逐漸習慣的過程（getting used to the cold weather）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Because the 'to' in 'be/get used to' is a preposition (not an infinitive marker), it takes a noun or '-ing': 'I am used to driving' (not 'drive'). By contrast, the 'to' in the past-habit 'used to' is an infinitive marker, so it takes the base verb: 'I used to drive.'
claims.verification_ref: be/get used to 的 to＝介系詞（接名詞/-ing）；used to（過去習慣）的 to＝不定詞記號（接原形）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'used to + base verb' describes a past habit or state that is no longer true.
teach.zh_hint: used to + 原形動詞＝過去的習慣或狀態（現在已經不是這樣了）。

teach.body: I used to live in London, but now I live in Taipei.
teach.zh_hint: 我以前住在倫敦，現在住在台北。used to + 原形 live 表過去習慣。

teach.body: 'be used to + noun or verb-ing' means you are already accustomed to something. Here 'to' is a preposition, so it is followed by an -ing form.
teach.zh_hint: be used to + 名詞／V-ing＝已經習慣某件事；這個 to 是介系詞，後面接 -ing。

teach.body: She is used to working late at night.
teach.zh_hint: 她已經習慣熬夜工作。be used to + working，to 是介系詞。

teach.body: 'get used to + noun or verb-ing' means you are gradually becoming accustomed to something.
teach.zh_hint: get used to + 名詞／V-ing＝逐漸變得習慣（強調過程）。

teach.body: It took me a while to get used to driving on the left.
teach.zh_hint: 我花了一陣子才習慣靠左開車。get used to + driving。

practice.stem: 選正確：When I was a child, I ____ a lot of comic books.（過去習慣，現在不再）

distractor_rationales.used to reading: 過去習慣的 used to 後面接原形（read），不是 -ing。
distractor_rationales.am used to read: be used to 的 to 是介系詞、要接名詞或 -ing；而且本句講的是過去習慣，不是『已習慣』。
distractor_rationales.was used to read: be used to 後面接名詞或 -ing（reading），不接原形 read；本句要表過去習慣，用 used to read。

practice.feedback: used to read：used to + 原形表過去習慣。

practice.stem: 選正確：I've lived here for years, so I ____ the noise from the street.（已經習慣這個狀態）

distractor_rationales.used to: used to 表過去習慣、後面要接原形動詞（used to hear）；要表『已習慣某名詞』用 be used to + 名詞。
distractor_rationales.am using to: 沒有 am using to 這個結構；『已習慣』是 be used to。
distractor_rationales.am used: 少了介系詞 to；正確是 am used to the noise。

practice.feedback: am used to the noise：be used to + 名詞表已習慣。

practice.stem: 選正確：After a month, he finally ____ getting up at 5 a.m.（逐漸習慣的過程）

distractor_rationales.used to: used to 表過去習慣、後接原形（used to get up）；本句強調『逐漸變習慣的過程』，用 get used to + V-ing。
distractor_rationales.got used: 少了介系詞 to；正確是 got used to getting up。
distractor_rationales.was use to: 拼寫/結構錯誤；『變得習慣』是 get used to。

practice.feedback: got used to getting up：get used to + V-ing 表逐漸習慣的過程。

practice.stem: 選正確：She is used to ____ in public; she does it every week.（be used to + V-ing）

distractor_rationales.speak: be used to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 -ing（speaking），不接原形 speak。
distractor_rationales.spoke: 這裡不接過去式；介系詞 to 後要用動名詞 speaking。
distractor_rationales.to speak: 已經有 to 了，不能再加一個 to；正確是 used to speaking。

practice.feedback: is used to speaking：be used to + V-ing（to 為介系詞）。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（我以前住在鄉下，但現在已經習慣城市生活了）
practice.answer: I used to live in the countryside, but now I am used to city life.
options: I used to live in the countryside, but now I am used to city life.
I am used to live in the countryside, but now I used to city life.
I used to living in the countryside, but now I am used to city life.
I used to live in the countryside, but now I am used to live in the city.

distractor_rationales.I am used to live in the countryside, bu: 前半 be used to 後接原形 live（應接名詞或 -ing）、後半 used to 後接名詞 city life（應接原形）都錯。
distractor_rationales.I used to living in the countryside, but: 過去習慣 used to 後面要接原形 live，不是 living。
distractor_rationales.I used to live in the countryside, but n: 後半 be used to 後面要接名詞或 -ing（living），不接原形 live。

practice.feedback: used to live（過去習慣＋原形）；am used to city life（已習慣＋名詞）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: It took me a while to get used to driving on the left.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：get used to driving（to + V-ing）、on the left、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。
